title: Integrated analysis of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) and mRNA expression profiles identifies lncRNA PRKG1-AS1 playing important roles in skeletal muscle aging.
authors: Zheng, Yan; Liu, Ting; Li, Qun; Li, Jie
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过lncRNA和mRNA表达谱分析及细胞实验探究骨骼肌衰老相关lncRNA功能，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to identify long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) involving in the skeletal muscle aging process. Skeletal muscle samples from old and young subjects were collected for lncRNA-sequencing. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and DElncRNAs between young and old groups were identified and a co-expression network was built. Further, a dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy cell model was established to characterize the function of a critical lncRNA. A total of 424 DEGs, including 271 upregulated genes and 153 downregulated genes as well as 152 DElncRNAs including 76 up-regulated and 76 down-regulated lncRNAs were obtained. Functional analysis demonstrated that the DEGs were significantly related to immune response. Coexpression network demonstrated lncRNA AC004797.1, PRKG1-AS1 and GRPC5D-AS1 were crucial lncRNAs. Their expressions were further validated by qRT-PCR in human skeletal muscle and the muscle atrophy cell model. Further in vitro analysis suggested that knock-down of PRKG1-AS1 could significantly increase cell viability and decrease cell apoptosis. qRT-PCR and western blot analyses demonstrated that knock-down of PRKG1-AS1 could increase the expression of MyoD, MyoG and Mef2c. This study demonstrated that lncRNAs of GPRC5D-AS1, AC004797.1 and PRKG1-AS1 might involve the aging-associated disease processes.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在识别参与骨骼肌衰老过程的长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）。收集老年和年轻受试者的骨骼肌样本进行lncRNA测序。鉴定年轻组与老年组之间的差异表达基因（DEGs）和差异表达lncRNAs（DElncRNAs），并构建共表达网络。进一步，建立地塞米松诱导的肌肉萎缩细胞模型，以表征关键lncRNA的功能。共获得424个DEGs，包括271个上调基因和153个下调基因，以及152个DElncRNAs，包括76个上调和76个下调的lncRNAs。功能分析表明，DEGs显著与免疫反应相关。共表达网络显示，lncRNA AC004797.1、PRKG1-AS1和GRPC5D-AS1是关键lncRNAs。其表达通过qRT-PCR在人骨骼肌和肌肉萎缩细胞模型中进一步验证。进一步的体外分析表明，敲低PRKG1-AS1可显著增加细胞活力并减少细胞凋亡。qRT-PCR和western blot分析显示，敲低PRKG1-AS1可增加MyoD、MyoG和Mef2c的表达。本研究表明，lncRNAs GPRC5D-AS1、AC004797.1和PRKG1-AS1可能参与衰老相关疾病过程。
